title: When the Encceja 2026 results are released
subtitle: The individual exam results are scheduled to be released on December 14th.
excerpt: Check the official date for the release of the Encceja 2026 results, along with details about the schedule and exam application rules.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: quando sai o resultado do encceja 2026
contentHtml:
The subject is gaining widespread repercussion among participants because the National Examination for the Certification of Competencies of Youth and Adults takes place this Sunday, August 23rd. With the evaluations being held in all Brazilian states and the Federal District, candidates are looking to understand the next steps of the official schedule established by the government.

Calendar and result date

The release of the individual Encceja 2026 results is scheduled for December 14th. The official calendar also includes important deadlines for specific situations, such as the request for reapplication, which must be made between August 24th and 28th. Meanwhile, the reapplication dates have been set for October 6th for elementary school and October 7th for high school.

Gate and exam schedules

The evaluations take place in two shifts, strictly following Brasília time. In the first shift, the gates open at 8:00 AM and close strictly at 8:45 AM, with the exams starting at 9:00 AM and ending at 1:00 PM. In the afternoon, the gates open at 2:30 PM, closing at 3:15 PM, with the exams starting at 3:30 PM and ending at 8:30 PM. Candidates entitled to additional time have 60 more minutes to finish the exam.

Mandatory documents for the exam

To gain access to the testing locations, it is mandatory to present an official, original photo ID issued by Brazilian agencies. Accepted documents include a passport, National Driver's License, National Identity Card, General Registry (RG), and digital documents presented via official apps. For foreign participants, a passport and the National Migration Registration Card are accepted. In addition, participants are required to bring a ballpoint pen with black ink made of transparent material.

Consulting the testing location

Enrollees can check the testing address through the Participant's Page by accessing the Registration Confirmation Card. As a new feature, the lookup can also be done via the Customer Service phone center using a virtual assistant, by providing the CPF and confirming the personal data requested by the automated system.

With information from the Federal Government, Guia do Estudante.
